summary: Scage Future, a Chinese zero-emission truck maker, filed a Form 6-K on September 2, 2026, disclosing two Nasdaq deficiency notifications received August 27, 2026. The company failed to maintain the required $50 million Market Value of Listed Securities and $15 million Market Value of Publicly Held Shares for 30 consecutive business days. Nasdaq granted a 180-day cure period through February 23, 2027, requiring ten consecutive trading days of compliance. Trading continues under SCAG with a deficiency indicator; potential outcomes include delisting appeal or transfer to Nasdaq Capital Market. Watch for compliance regain or delisting timelines.
